title: Carney Slams U.S.-Canada Trade Proposal and Vows Retaliation
summary_full: Prime Minister Mark Carney gave a powerful speech to Canadians on Saturday morning, hours after ordering negotiators to suspend U.S. trade talks despite President Trump’s punishing tariffs.
